info.title: Products API
info.description: RESTful API to manage products and their prices in multiple currencies. Log in with POST /auth/login and send the returned opaque token as a Bearer token.

post.description: Exchanges credentials for an opaque bearer token. The token abilities match the user's permissions.
Revokes the token used for this request only.

put.description: PUT replaces every field; PATCH updates only the fields sent.

delete.description: Fails with 409 when a product or price still references the currency.

get.description: Reports whether the application and its database are reachable.
Paginated, filterable by search text, currency and price range, and sortable.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description: Optionally creates additional prices in other currencies in the same transaction.

put.description: PUT replaces every field; PATCH updates only the fields sent.

delete.description: Soft delete: the product disappears from the API but the row is kept.

get.summary: List the additional prices of a product

post.description: The currency must differ from the product base currency and be unique per product.
post.summary: Add a price to a product

http.description: Opaque Sanctum personal access token (not a JWT). Obtain it from POST /auth/login and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
